scope: Experimental measurements, not authoritative recovery state; recovery.json alone records acceptance.

effort.intervention_definition: 4 initial calibration families, 1 inline/index-order expansion, 1 table-pointer family, 1 guarded-cursor family, 1 blind zero-store family. Does not count tooling implementation, semantics work, first-pass reconstruction or reporting.

blind.promotion: Four raw-equal blind results retained for later review; no blind functions promoted in this experiment.

validation.note: Replay comparisons assert all source hashes and retained metrics reproduce. Generated build reports remain ignored.

conclusion: Mixed support: one localized store-order tail converged in one variant; no calibration target reached equality. No demonstrated broad speedup or numeric routing threshold.
